title: GRACE log line (Unpeeked Seed shrine, per roll)
description: One line per grace-shrine roll, peeked or unpeeked. Supersedes the free-form 'GRACE t=<mm:ss> d1= d2= total= pass=' line named in BURN_third-way-game_20260925.md the same way THIRD_WAY_VOW_LOG_SCHEMA.json locked the VOW-TAKEN line. Schema-consistency rule (extends the 2026-09-26 receipt): peeked and unpeeked rolls MUST log identical field sets; the seed audit compares distributions across the shared fields only. The raw session seed must NEVER appear in any log line; seed_hash carries the sha256 of the seed instead.

seat.description: Seat name of the rolling character (NPC=SEAT law).

t.description: Roll timestamp, ISO-8601 UTC (trailing Z required).

pair_id.description: Identifier shared by the peeked and unpeeked legs of one seed-matched audit pair.

seed_hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the hourly session seed. Never the seed itself. Both legs of a pair must carry the same seed_hash.

mode.description: Which leg of the pair this roll belongs to.

improbable_spent.description: Improbability resource consumed by the Drive for this roll (canon: luck is spent, not free).

roll_total.description: The 2d6 sum. Pass on 7; the audit expects totals >= 7 at the raw 2d6 rate (15/36, about 41.7 percent) with no smoothing.

outcome.description: miss: total < 7. pass: total >= 7. grace: pass via the grace pool rather than the raw total.

grace_pool_id.description: Grace pool the roll draws from (empty string when none applies).
